cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Move It for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Move your haircut so we can have lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. We've been friends since school. Couldn't I have its place just once?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They charge twenty pounds if I change it today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll pay. Put lunch in that exact slot, in pen. You've used pencil for me since school.

mechanism: A grants the terms of rearranging a haircut so a friend must visibly put the relationship into the protected appointment slot.
confusable: D10 wants to be chosen over another option; D35 specifically needs rearrangement as proof of relationship priority.
comparison: A paid cancellation and calendar slot differ from the exhibition alternative public explanation to a quiz team.
seedUse: Use D35-a longstanding friendship, fee and pen-versus-pencil symbolism, with S01 approval controlling the rescheduling concession.
